title: Understand the problem before reading the implementation
goal: Make every Plan easy to assess in German and English.
summary: Publish one bilingual Plan with a language switch, an immediate summary and a visual problem overview. Share evidence and decisions across both languages.

problem.statement: Readers must scan long implementation details to understand the actual problem.
problem.impact: Decisions take longer and the intended outcome is easily missed.
problem.approach: Lead with a short summary and a four-stage overview; offer German and English.
problem.outcome: Readers understand what changes, why it matters and how success will be demonstrated.
